== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：ドッキング・ベイ327</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">2フォース消費して、ここから他のドッキング・ベイへ移動できる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">フォースを消費せずに、ここから他のドッキング・ベイへ移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. You may use 2 Force to move from here to another docking bay. Dark Side. You may move from here to another docking bay without using Force.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese omits English “Your”. Light spends 2 Force to move. Dark moves without using Force instead of “transit from here is free”. One asterisk. One Light Force icon and one Dark Force icon.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-deathstardockingbay327.gif|Original English face]], [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark)]].</ref>
